[[File:TreasureHunterMercenary-GH.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A mercenary treasure hunter]]
'''Treasure hunting''' is the activity of [[Archaeology/Legends|tracking down valuable items or artifacts]] with the intent of keeping them, or selling them for profit. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] adventurers could specialize in this with the intent of tracking down rare gemstones, rare lockboxes and other valuable items. Later, [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] would engage in treasure hunting on behalf of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Treasure hunting is one of the available crew skill players of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' can specialize in. The awards gained are varied but often contain items used for artifice or lockboxes with possible credit yield.
